    • markRotated

      @Transactional @Modifying(flushAutomatically=true) @Query("UPDATE EgradxRefreshTokenEntity t SET t.rotatedAt = :now WHERE t.id = :id AND t.rotatedAt IS NULL") int markRotated(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("now") Instant now)

    • deleteExpired

      @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM EgradxRefreshTokenEntity t WHERE t.expiryDate < :now") int deleteExpired(@Param("now") Instant now)
      Tokens past their expiry, revoked or not. A revoked one is kept until then on purpose: until it would have expired, a client presenting it is told why it was signed out.
